text:
carla: @channel urgent hotfix for tokenizer regression in eu-west1. Canary failing consistency tests. Need to push patch to staging -> prod during midnight window. Can we fast-track canary skip with approvals? deploy-bot kicked off canary run 3187654321.

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] hotfix/build-2026.03.18-rc2 queued for canary in staging-eu-west1. Auto-canary timeout 15m. To skip canary include approvals: 2x eng + 1x oncall. Actions: react :thumbsup: to approve, or reply +1.

ben: Linking failing test logs: http://ci/internal/12345 . Root cause is tokenizer index off-by-one. Patch is tiny.

alice: I reviewed PR #7689. LGTM. If we skip canary we must have a rollback command and a canary rollback ticket. Proposed rollback: `./deploy rollback --env=prod --tag=build-2026.03.17` short window.

ops-oncall: Oncall assigned this window is me. We have spare capacity in eu-west1 v2 pool. If anything spikes, I'll pause traffic and route to eu-west2.

sre_lead: +1 from SRE if ops is oncall and rollback tested. Also need owners on rotation for 30m post-deploy.

security: Any data-migration? no. But confirm KMS key usage and audit log retention. Please confirm.

carla: No data changes. KMS unchanged. Audit logs enabled. @security acknowledged?

security: Confirmed. OK from security.

ben: vote +1 (react :shipit:). alice +1.

deploy-bot: APPROVAL_COUNT=3, required=2 eng +1 oncall; Oncall present: ops-oncall. Canary skip allowed. Executing deploy to prod in 2m. Will stream logs here.

deploy-bot: [STREAM] Starting rollout: prod/eu-west1 -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Keep an eye on latency and error-rate.

alice: Quick healthcheck script:
```
curl -sS https://prod.eu-west1.health/tokenizer | jq .
```
Run it after 50% step.

ops-oncall: 50% stage: latency +15% but errors stable. Pausing progression for 3m to observe.

deploy-bot: Progress: 20% -> 50%. hold requested by ops-oncall.

carla: Oncall hold acknowledged. Any sign of regression? ops?

ops-oncall: after 3m no increase in 5xx. moving to 100% in 30s.

deploy-bot: Progress: 100%. Deploy complete. build-2026.03.18-rc2 -> prod. Duration 8m.

sre_lead: Post-deploy checklists green. Marking as done. Please file a short postmortem if anything crops up.

ben: Thanks team. Filing short note in release notes channel.

carla: Closing thread. :tada:
